method: Model-generated unlabelled raster artwork + actual-font text overlay; no tracing, texture cleanup or geometric reconstruction.

history.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create a NEW UNLABELLED PNG mechanism diagram of an RBM's alternating stochastic block updates and likelihood-gradient statistics. Two supplied external Hinton lecture figures give the bipartite conditional structure and alternating Gibbs timeline; use their content, independently design the new layout. Ideally a spacious landscape about 2400 by 1350 pixels.

TOP AREA: one valid illustrative sampling trajectory for a model with EXACTLY TWO visible variables and ONE hidden variable. A visible-state strip with TWO circular cells, both filled blue, flows into a white hidden-conditional probability module. That probability module flows through a distinct random-sampling operation, then outputs ONE filled green circular hidden-state cell. This sampled hidden state flows into a second white visible-conditional probability module, through another distinct random-sampling operation, then outputs TWO visible-state cells, the first blue filled and second white empty. Thus the visible trajectory starts with both active and this one possible next sample has only its first component active. The probability modules must be visually different from the sampled binary-state cells: probabilities are not next-step states. Leave ample space for exact probability text and formula labels in the probability modules; DO NOT use arbitrary-height data bars or numerals. Both stochastic operations may use the SAME small flat die glyph beside their later headings, at most one each. A clean outgoing continuation arrow after the final visible strip indicates repeated alternating Gibbs steps; no deterministic reconstruction claim. Keep chronological arrows left-to-right, no hidden-to-hidden or visible-to-visible graphical-model edges. Model parameters are fixed during this chain.

BOTTOM AREA: distinguish DATA positive statistics from MODEL negative statistics. One data-statistics block, fed by the data/start-visible side and the hidden conditional probability, can use the exact conditional expectation without sampling. Another model-statistics block is fed by the continued chain on the right and estimates a joint correlation from model samples. Both feed a central or right gradient-DIFFERENCE operation, with the data branch and model branch kept distinct. Its output can point to a weight-update object, OUTSIDE the upper fixed-parameter sampling trajectory. Leave an open generous formula area around the gradient difference and both statistical blocks. Actual fonts will add the positive-minus-negative sign, expectation expressions, and sampling warning. Do not wire a probability vector directly into the next state or suggest a finite short chain is an exact model expectation.

Use flat binary-state circles and sparse statistical/matrix mechanisms, not an all-card dashboard. White background, mostly white modules, a few independently bounded extremely pale grouping areas. Lancet blue #7B95C6 visible/data, green #67A583 hidden/conditionals, peach #F59C7C stochastic sampling, rose #C85E62 negative statistics and restrained cyan #49C2D9 final gradient. Uniform 18% or 22% mixtures with white. Thin neutral-gray arrows, clean endpoints, generous label clearance. No more than one decorative icon in any frame; same sampling glyph in both repeated operations.

Absolutely no words, letters, numerals, formulas, plus/minus signs, pseudo-text, legends or watermark. All circles, probability modules and statistic panels remain unlabelled. Pure #FFFFFF canvas and perfectly even flat pure-color regions. No 3D, perspective, extrusion, spherical nodes, shadow, gloss, gradient, paper/canvas texture, noise, ripples, stripes or clouded fills. Keep all objects inside an airy canvas and reserve the exact labels for real-font typography added afterwards.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Make only TWO kinds of local graphic corrections in this NEW RBM preview. Preserve ALL other shapes, fills, canvas, layout, node counts, solid arrows and their endpoints.
First, BOTH stochastic sampling dice must be identical flat front-facing 2D rounded SQUARES with three simple dark dots on the one face. Remove every top/side perspective surface, extrusion and shadow; no cube, no 3D. Keep their positions and space around them.
Second, in the BOTTOM parameter-update frame, remove its THREE empty circular nodes. Replace them with ONE small flat blank TWO-ROWS by ONE-COLUMN matrix grid, located toward the LEFT side of that frame, leaving clear blank space to its RIGHT for the weight-update title and formula to be added using genuine fonts. This is a WEIGHT update object, not a third layer of stochastic units. Do not change the central blank gradient-difference circle or add any symbols.
Preserve exactly TWO visible cells in the first state, ONE sampled hidden cell, TWO visible cells in the final state with only the first filled. All sampling trajectory and data/model-statistic inputs retain their connections. White #FFFFFF background, uniform very pale flat Lancet fills, no grain, noise, paper texture, ripples, stripes, gradient, clouding, shadow, gloss or 3D. No text, letters, numerals, formulas, punctuation, pseudo-text, plus/minus signs or watermark.

reference_policy: Two content-relevant external primary-source figures were passed via referenced_image_paths in the initial call. Repairs used only this task’s new unlabelled candidate. No textbook old figure was passed.

selected.prompt: Make a color-only edit of this exact no-text technical drawing. Preserve EVERY component position, margin, scale, all grids/row and column counts, node counts, connectors, arrow direction, line endpoints, layer glyphs and label whitespace. Never redraw its topology or rearrange content. Apply the palette to EVERY colored frame, fill, circle, bar, arrow and line; leave NO original high saturation pigment. Blue/cyan becomes muted #7188A3 and #E5EAF0; green #829C8B/#E8EEE9; yellow/orange #B4A16F/#F1ECDD; red/pink #A7787D/#F0E5E6; purple #9588A5/#ECE8F0. Use blue for main generic modules/output, red only for errors/loss or an indispensable distinct series. Ordinary boxes rounded about 6px. Background pure white; neutral wires #556170. No shadows, texture, gradients, letters, numbers, or pseudo text. Preserve exact canvas aspect ratio and all empty label spaces. Preserve natural input images and data point relations.
